stemBlocks: A car is at rest on a straight horizontal road. At time $t = 0 \text{s}$ the car starts to move along the road. The graph shows how its acceleration varies from $t = 0 \text{s}$ to $t = 20 \text{s}$.
What is the displacement of the car from its starting position when $t = 20 \text{s}$?

assets.alt: Graph showing acceleration / m s$^{-2}$ versus time / s. From $t=0$ to $t=10 \text{s}$, acceleration is $2.0 \text{ m s}^{-2}$. From $t=10$ to $t=20 \text{s}$, acceleration is $-1.5 \text{ m s}^{-2}$.
